storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP FanslyLive Downloader makes it easy to record live streams and save recordings from Fansly.com.

How it works: Go to any live model page on Fansly, open the extension popup or click the Download button on the player, select your quality, and hit Start. The extension captures the HLS stream in real time, counting segments as they arrive. When you're done, click Stop -- the captured segments are converted to a standard MP4 file and saved to your Downloads folder.

For VOD recordings (model video pages), it works just like a standard downloader -- select quality and click Download.

It handles HLS playlist parsing, multi-CDN host probing, and Fansly API integration automatically -- no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save to an organized FANSLYLIVE subfolder.

Key features:
- Live stream capture with Start/Stop controls
- Real-time segment counting and elapsed time display
- VOD recording download support
- VR stream detection with camera settings metadata
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available HLS variants
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick captures
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Fansly.com and open a live model page
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and click Start -- recording begins
5. Click Stop when done -- saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited use.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any live model page on Fansly.com. Open the extension popup or click the download button on the player. Select your quality and click Start. The extension records the stream in real time. Click Stop when you want to end the recording.

faq.question: Can I download VOD recordings too?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to a model's video page (e.g., /username/videos/12345) and the extension works as a standard downloader -- select quality and click Download.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available HLS variants from the stream -- typically multiple resolutions. Formats are listed by resolution (e.g., 1080p, 720p) with bandwidth information.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a FANSLYLIVE subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited use.

faq.question: Does this support VR streams?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects VR streams and includes VR camera settings (stereo packing, frame format, horizontal angle) in the download metadata and filename.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes -- supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding the stream?
faq.answer: Make sure the model is actually live and streaming. If the model is offline or in a private show, the extension will display a status message. Refresh the page if issues persist.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Stream processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP -- no passwords stored.
